identity.title: List of Pocket Monsters BW volumes

leadText: This is a list of volumes of the manga created by 穴久保幸作 Kosaku Anakubo. There are four volumes in total currently released in Japan by Shogakukan. The Pocket Monsters BW manga has not been officially translated into English.
